name: The Glass Hermit Crab's Treasure Cove
description: A tiny glass cabin perched on a cliff edge, inhabited by a hermit crab wearing a tiny lantern, inside a glowing treasure chest, luminous pearls and coins glisten around.
prompt: Small glass hermit crab cabin perched on a cliff, interior showing a tiny glowing treasure chest with glittering pearls and gold coins, crab with tiny lantern on shell, surrounding sea of turquoise water, sunset reflections, whimsical, highly detailed.
caption: Even the smallest shells hold grand treasures 🦀💎 Discover the hermit crab's glittering cove.
